McCrea' in the last column, 'Names of Retired Members deemed to be Re-elected'

note: Triennial election of Castlederg Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. There was one contest, in Castlegore, the first in the district for thirty years; the other divisions were uncontested and are listed as the nomination report prints them. The returning officer's count at Castlederg was held on the night of the poll. Ardarver, Clunahill and Corgary are added from the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Ulster Herald, 13 June 1964, p. 8), which names their members as retired members deemed to be re-elected (7 Nov 2026). Deemed re-elected, as the notice records; the notice also prints his name in the candidate columns. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
